buyer_closing_costs.disney_admin_fee_notes: Flat $500 per resale transfer, paid by buyer (dvcmarket.com closing-costs guide; disneyblog.com describes it as new in 2026). Not independently verified on a Disney page.
buyer_closing_costs.prorated_current_year_dues: Buyer reimburses seller for dues already paid for the remainder of the calendar year (pro-rated by closing date).

hawaii_conveyance_tax.notes: dvcmarket.com claims $0.10/$100 'up to certain thresholds' — Hawaii's actual schedule distinguishes homeowner-exemption-eligible vs not-eligible (non-owner-occupied typically $0.15/$100 under $600k). Could not reach tax.hawaii.gov to verify; customarily a seller cost in Hawaii (Old Republic Title allocation sheet). Immaterial on a typical contract (<$40).

financed_vs_cash.notes: DVC resale loans are typically unsecured/personal-style loans; no verified per-broker financed closing-cost schedule found. dvcmarket.com says to add lender origination fees (if any) on top of the $500-$1,000 closing + $500 CAF; bestdvcbroker.com lists lenders from 11.99% APR (no origination fee) and 13.9% APR. Treat financed_extra as lender-specific.

buyer_closing_costs.by_broker_notes: Brokers do not publish itemized buyer closing-cost schedules; only Fidelity's $250 buyer admin fee is a known broker-specific add-on.

seller_costs.commission_notes: DVCRM 9.5% and Fidelity 8.5% per bestdvcbroker.com and dvcmarket.com broker comparison (2026); DVC Resale Experts 9% is a 'reduced' listing rate stated on its own homepage; DVC Sales 6.9% per its own (dvcmarket.com is owned by DVC Sales — biased source). Confirm before listing.

hawaii_harpta.applies_to: Non-resident (of Hawaii) sellers of Hawaii real property, incl. Aulani; withheld from gross amount realized at closing
hawaii_harpta.recovery: Refundable via Hawaii non-resident income tax return; can apply for reduced withholding with Form N-288B/N-288C
hawaii_harpta.notes: 7.25% verified in official Hawaii Form N-288 instructions (2025). Fidelity's glossary still says 5% — that was the pre-Sept-2018 rate and is outdated.

seller_costs.firpta: Federal FIRPTA withholding applies only to foreign-person sellers; not applicable for US-resident sellers.

aulani_transient_accommodations_tax.applies_to: All points stays at Aulani regardless of home resort; paid at check-out, not included in dues
aulani_transient_accommodations_tax.formula: nightly_tax = nightly_points x (annual_dues_per_point_for_stay_year x 0.5) x (state_TAT + Honolulu_TAT)
aulani_transient_accommodations_tax.per_point_2027_notes: 2027 TAT chart not yet published (2027 dues set ~Nov/Dec 2026). Estimate = 0.5 x 2027 Aulani dues x 14% if rates unchanged (e.g. +6-8% dues -> ~$0.81-0.83/pt).
aulani_transient_accommodations_tax.cash_stays_note: Cash (non-points) reservations additionally pay Hawaii GET 4.712% (not points stays).

offer_and_closing.typical_deposit_notes: ~10% of purchase price into escrow, varies by broker (dvcmarket.com closing-timeline article). Not verified on DVCRM/Fidelity sites.
offer_and_closing.closing_timeline_notes: No source publishes separate FL vs HI timelines. Plan 60-90 days from signed contract to points in account (DVCRM/Fidelity). Aulani closings involve HARPTA withholding paperwork for non-resident sellers which may add time — unverified.

dvc_rules.resale_restriction: Resale contracts bought after Jan 19, 2019 (from non-Disney sellers) cannot book some or all non-home resorts: legacy-resort resale points book only the 14 original resorts (Riviera, Disneyland Hotel, Fort Wilderness Cabins and later resorts excluded).
dvc_rules.banking_deadline: Must bank within the first 8 months of the Use Year (i.e., at least 4 months before Use Year ends); bank only from current UY into next UY; banked points cannot be re-banked or borrowed; banking final.
dvc_rules.borrowing: May borrow up to 100% of next Use Year's points into the current Use Year (restored July 2022 after COVID-era 50% cap).
dvc_rules.cancellation_holding: Cancel 31+ days before arrival: points returned to UY normally. Cancel 30-1 days: points go to Holding account (rebookable only within 60 days of arrival, no further banking). Same-day cancel: points forfeited.
dvc_rules.rci_deposit_deadline: Deposit for RCI at least 45 days before end of Use Year.

dues_billing.basis: Calendar year (Jan-Dec), regardless of Use Year
dues_billing.rates_published: ~late November for the following year; boards approve at association meetings in early-mid December; balances posted mid-December
dues_billing.monthly_option: Auto-pay: 12 interest-free monthly installments from a US bank account; must be enrolled by Feb 14/15 or full balance due. Gift cards not allowed while on auto-pay; credit card allowed only for full payment by deadline.
dues_billing.property_tax_true_up: Annual statement includes prior-year property-tax over/under estimate adjustment.

dvc_rental_store.notes: 'Up to $24/pt' paid to members (all resorts); confirmed Aulani reservation listed at $24/pt (414 pts 2BR, Nov 1-7 2026) on the David's site.

aulani_2026.notes: Aulani is a 'Premium' tier at David's. Use ~$18-20/pt as realistic owner net and ~$24-26/pt as guest price.

notes: Many closing-cost figures come from dvcmarket.com, which is owned by a competing broker (DVC Sales) — ranges are reasonable but not authoritative.
Official DVC FAQ pages (disneyvacationclub.disney.go.com) are JS-rendered and could not be fetched; banking rule taken from Disney's official Banking rules PDF, booking windows from DVCRM.
Florida-vs-Hawaii closing timelines, per-broker financed closing costs, and 2027 Aulani TAT are not published: left null.
